hero.sub: Milestone escrow for deals between strangers. / An AI verifies the evidence, a deterministic engine moves the money, / and every decision is signed and anchored.
hero.whyChain: Money never touches the chain. Rupees move on Razorpay the entire time. The chain holds exactly two things: the rulebook of the deal, so neither party can quietly edit it after the fact, and a fingerprint of every AI decision, so the claim that an AI decided can be replaced with a verifiable record.
hero.fixtureProvider: scored by the deterministic offline adapter — no model key configured
hero.noEvalYet: No eval run is recorded yet. Run make eval and these figures appear.
hero.whyChainTitle: The money never touches the chain.
pillars: Rupees move on Razorpay from start to finish. There is no token, no coin and nothing to stake.
The chain holds the rulebook of the deal, so neither side can quietly edit the terms after the evidence arrives.
The chain holds a fingerprint of every AI decision, so “an AI decided” can be replaced with a record anyone can re-check.

chain.title: ON-CHAIN ANCHORS

chain.note: Anchoring is an audit aid, not a settlement step. A failed anchor never blocks or reverses a payout.

ledger.note: A non-zero outbox backlog means the relay is behind, not that an event was lost. A non-zero DLQ depth means something needs a human.

invitation.title: Join an organization
invitation.signInFirst: Sign in with a verified email first. An invitation grants access to another organization's deals, so it is accepted by an account that has proven it holds the mailbox — not by whoever opens the link.
